description: Removes signs of AI generation from English text and prevents them from appearing in new writing. Works on three levels: typography and mechanics, vocabulary and rhetoric, structure and epistemics. Use whenever the user asks to "humanize", "unslop", "de-AI", "make this sound human", "remove the AI style", "make it not sound generated". Also apply from the first draft when writing ANY English text for people: posts, articles, emails, reports, docs, landing pages, product copy. Do not wait to be asked. If the text is in English and a person will read it, this skill applies.
